We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for this case.

Facts: Zhao1 is legal representative of a company. Zhao2 is former mayor. Zhao2 instructed government procurement office to purchase white wine from Zhao1's company, value 1.2 million yuan, for government reception. Later Zhao1 gave Zhao2 300,000 yuan in cash in Zhao2's office, as a bribe to thank for procurement and to continue being designated supplier. Zhao2 accepted.

Thus, this is a case of bribery: the company (unit) and its legal representative gave bribe to a state functionary (public official) to obtain procurement. The appropriate charge: "单位行贿" (unit bribery) and "行贿" (bribe). Since the defendant is a legal representative of a company, the company is a unit, so the charge is "单位行贿". The individual also may be charged with "行贿". In Chinese criminal law, the legal representative can be charged with "单位行贿罪" (unit bribery) and also "行贿罪" (bribery) if personal.
